jobs.title: (Senior) Software Developer (m/w/d) für .NET-Anwendungen
jobs.description:
**(Senior) Software Developer (m/w/d) für .NET-Anwendungen**
============================================================

Ort: Stuttgart Degerloch

14 Gehälter ab dem 2. Jahr

38h / Woche

Die ALH Gruppe auf LinkedIn

Flexible Arbeitszeit und FlexWork

Die ALH Gruppe auf Instagram

**Eine Gruppe. Viele Möglichkeiten.**

Als erfahrenes Versicherungs- und Finanzdienstleistungsunternehmen verbinden wir seit 1819 Wachstum mit Tradition. Rund 3.200 Mitarbeitende sorgen täglich dafür, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden bestens abgesichert sind und einen ausgezeichneten Service erhalten. Bei uns erwartet dich ein Arbeitsumfeld voller Offenheit, Teamgeist und Rückhalt. Gemeinsam mit dir formen wir aus unseren individuellen Kompetenzen ein starkes Team: die ALH Gruppe. Erfahre hier mehr über uns als Arbeitgeber.

  
  

In der Anwendungsentwicklung sorgen unsere IT-Spezialisten täglich dafür, dass die Dienstprogramme, Datenbanken und Anwendungen zuverlässig und technisch einwandfrei laufen und die Fachbereiche damit bestens arbeiten können. Steige ein in unser erfahrenes und motiviertes Entwicklerteam am **Standort Stuttgart** und entfalte dein Potenzial, je nach deinen persönlichen Skills und Vorlieben, um gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Krankenversicherung zu gestalten!

  
  
  
  
**Deine Aufgaben:**

* Design und Implementierung von geschäftskritischen Anwendungen mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
* Aktive Mitgestaltung der Modernisierung und des Neuaufbaus unserer Anwendungslandschaft
* Entwicklung von Anwendungen im Frontend- und Backendbereich je nach persönlichen Vorlieben, sowie Definition von technischen Standards und Best Practices
* Übernahme einer zentralen Rolle in agilen Teams – von der fachlichen Analyse über Architekturentscheidungen bis zum Go-Live
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen sowie Beratung bei technischen Fragestellungen und Lösungsdesigns
* Leitung von (Teil-)Projekten sowie fachliche Unterstützung und Mentoring von weniger erfahrenen Entwicklern
  

  
  
**Deine Kompetenzen:**

* Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, einer Naturwissenschaft oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung – z. B. als Fachinformatiker – sowie mehrjährige relevante Berufspraxis
* Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Projekten im .NET-Umfeld unter Einsatz von C# sowie gängigen Webtechnologien (z. B. JavaScript, HTML, CSS)
* Wünschenswert: Erfahrung in der Leitung von IT-Projekten und in der fachlichen Führung von Entwicklern
* Erfahrung im Einsatz moderner Integrations- und Laufzeittechnologien wie RabbitMQ und Dapr
* Tiefgehendes Verständnis moderner Software-Architekturen (z. B. eventbasierte Architekturen, Domain-driven Design, verteilte Systeme, Webservices)
* Sicherer Umgang mit Software-Design-Prinzipien und -Patterns (z. B. SOLID)
* Praxis im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Integrationsparadigmen und Schnittstellentechnologien (z. B. REST, JSON sowie auch SOAP/WSDL)
* Erfahrung mit Authentifizierungs- und Sicherheitsmechanismen (OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT)
* Know-how im effizienten Einsatz von KI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen (z. B. zur Unterstützung bei Analyse, Implementierung und Qualitätssicherung)
* Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen sowie strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
* Hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Teamgeist, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und nicht zuletzt sicheres Deutsch (mindestens C1-Niveau)
  

  
  
**Unser Versprechen:**

* **Attraktive Vergütung**: Vierzehn Monatsgehälter ab dem 2. Jahr der Betriebszugehörigkeit
* **Flexible Arbeitszeit**: 38-Stunden-Woche mit Gleitzeit und hybridem Arbeiten
* **Mehr Freizeit**: 30 Urlaubstage – zusätzlich frei am 24.12. und 31.12.
* **Und vieles mehr**: Erfahre hier mehr über unsere Benefits
  

  
  

**Dein Kontakt**

Bei Rückfragen rund um die Bewerbung hilft Dir unser Karriere-Team gerne weiter!

  
  
  

**Saskia Abt, Dorothee Mönch**  
**Personalmanagement Oberursel / Stuttgart**

**saskia.abt@hallesche.de, dorothee.moench@hallesche.de**

ALH Gruppe
  
www.alh.de/deine-karriere

  

**Interesse geweckt? Dann bewirb dich direkt über unser Online-Formular!**

  
  
  

Die ALH Gruppe begrüßt ausdrücklich die Bewerbung von Menschen mit Behinderung.

  
  
  

Hinweis: Zur besseren Lesbarkeit wird in der Stellenanzeige die männliche Form verwendet. Sie gilt für alle Geschlechter.

jobs.title: Salesforce Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Salesforce Developer to join our vibrant technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing customized Salesforce solutions that enhance our customer relationship management capabilities. Your expertise will drive seamless integration with various platforms and ensure our Salesforce environment operates efficiently and securely. This is an exciting opportunity to leverage your technical skills to deliver impactful solutions that support our business growth and improve user experience.

**Duties**

* Develop, customize, and optimize Salesforce applications using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, and other Salesforce tools to meet business requirements.
* Integrate Salesforce with external systems through APIs, REST services, and other middleware solutions to ensure data consistency and real-time updates.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and deliver scalable solutions.
* Maintain version control using SVN or GitHub, ensuring code quality and proper documentation throughout the development lifecycle.
* Perform troubleshooting, debugging, and performance tuning of Salesforce applications to maximize efficiency.
* Support deployment processes by managing release cycles, conducting testing, and ensuring smooth transitions between environments.
* Stay current with Salesforce platform updates and industry best practices to continually improve system functionality.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in software development with a strong focus on application development within the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as JavaScript, Java, C#, Python, Ruby on Rails, C++, C, VBA, and.NET frameworks.
* Hands-on experience working with APIs (RESTful services), SQL databases (MySQL, MS SQL), and cloud platforms like AWS or Azure.
* Familiarity with version control systems including GitHub and SVN for managing code repositories.
* Knowledge of front-end development techniques including Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Visualforce pages.
* Experience working on Linux environments and utilizing tools like Git for collaboration.
* Strong understanding of software development best practices including Agile methodologies and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
* Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex issues quickly and effectively.
* Effective communication skills to collaborate across teams and translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

Join us as a Salesforce Developer to be at the forefront of innovative technology solutions! Your expertise will help shape our digital future while providing enriching opportunities for professional growth in a fast-paced environment committed to excellence.

Pay: Up to £70,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (C# / .NET, Vue, Azure)
jobs.description:
We're building the OS for the digital workspace: strategic transformation supported by data from the edge, day-to-day operations automated at scale, and end user devices deployed anywhere in the world at the click of a button.

The platform is being built now. What you write will be in production quickly and used by named enterprise customers, rather than sitting in a backlog.

This is a hands-on build role. A handful of engineers own the whole platform, so you will own features end to end: schema, API, front end, deployment, and whatever breaks at 4pm on a Thursday. There's no separate platform team, so you'll see your work all the way through — with the rest of the team alongside you.

What you'll do

–Build front-end and back-end features on our core stack: C# / .NET, TypeScript, Vue, SQL Server, Azure

–Design and consume APIs, and integrate third-party platforms so they hold up in production

–Build and maintain our Azure services (App Services, Functions, Storage) using infrastructure as code (Bicep), and tune the database for performance and reliability

–Build and maintain our CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps (there's no separate DevOps team), and ship deployments that don't need a rollback

–Write unit tests with real coverage that hold up beyond the happy path

–Monitor logs, alerts, and error reporting, and fix infrastructure problems before a customer reports them

–Use AI coding tools (we use Claude Code) to move faster, and review every line of the output before it lands

What we're looking for: We are not fixed on years of experience. We are fixed on whether you can build and run production software on this stack.

–Strong C# / .NET and TypeScript, with solid Vue experience

–SQL Server: you can model data properly and diagnose a slow query yourself

–Hands-on Azure experience in a production environment

–Git and Azure DevOps

–Code that is structured, secure, and right-sized for the problem, and you know where that balance sits

–Comfortable being one of a handful of engineers, with the autonomy and the exposure that comes with it

–Strong communication and collaboration. You explain your thinking clearly, work well with people outside engineering, and own your mistakes as readily as your wins

–UK-based, with the existing right to work in the UK. This role is remote within the UK only. We are not able to sponsor visas or employ from outside the UK.

Nice to have

–Charting libraries, particularly eCharts

–End-user computing or IT support background, which gives you the context for what we're building

–A portfolio or public repos we can look at

How we work

Fully remote across the UK, with the whole team getting together at head office every so often, and we'd want you to enjoy that side of it too. Small team, short decision chains, no layers to route around. You will talk directly to the people who use the product and to the people who sell it. We back new tools and frameworks where they earn their place, and we'd want you making the case for the ones you think we should adopt.

Pay: £45,000.00-£75,000.00 per year

Application question(s):

* Are you currently based in the UK?
* Do you have the right to work in the UK without visa sponsorship, now and for the duration of employment?
* How many years of commercial experience do you have with C# / .NET?
* How many years of commercial experience do you have with Vue (2 or 3)?
* Have you built, managed, and deployed applications to Azure infrastructure?
* Which of these have you used in a production role? (Azure DevOps / SQL Server performance tuning / CI-CD pipeline ownership / eCharts or similar charting library)
* Briefly: describe a production incident you diagnosed and fixed yourself.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in London

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Technical sales professional, owning the Cisco brand with customers and partners. Provides technical solutions to address customer and partner business needs. Collaborates with the account team and connected sales teams on the customer plan, jointly ensuring customer success. Serves as an expert or trusted technical advisor by the account team and customer/partner.
  
  
**What we are looking for:**  

* Specialization and Focus - Strong knowledge of Cisco’s portfolio, including specialized/architecture perspective, increases penetration via cross/up-selling and displaces competition, Owns technical relationship with customer(s)/partner(s)
* Customer Engagement and Accountability - Leads engagements with IT& decision makers at customer/partner and LOB interaction, Knowledgeable of customer environment and market, including competitor plays, Primary technical sales influencer, translates customer/partner business need into technical requirements

The Internal Sales Process, most selling time spent landing opportunities and expanding within an account, Involved in customer strategic planning
  

* Corporate Interlock - Provides active feedback to BEs and relevant sales teams on strategic customer needs and market opportunities, and competitive market tactics
* Typical Sales Cycle - Takes the lead on moving deals across technical sales process, Designs and presents relevant solution based on technical and business requirements identified by the customer or partner, manages virtual support team of sales resources, leverages relevant tools and resources to support a deal
* Success Measures - Increase revenue: Closed opportunities converted to closed deals, displace a competitor/increased market share, increase net new customers on a quarterly basis

**What You'll Do:**  

* Leads multi-year strategic plans by integrating Cisco’s portfolio with its ecosystem and partner network
* Leverages deep expertise of Cisco’s portfolio to create new knowledge and collaborates with engineering to shape future products
* Leads organizations’ technical strategy as a trusted technology and business advisor to C-suite executives
* Unifies customer’s business vision with emerging industry trends to develop cross-architecture solutions
* Leads disruptive cross-architecture roadmaps for customers
* Conceives the overarching vision for demand generation and enablement imperatives
* Unlocks customer’s untapped market potential through cross-architecture strategies
* Steers demonstrations to showcase tailored solutions, driving transformation and meeting key business objectives
* Utilizes advanced competitive intelligence to drive sustainable market advantage for Cisco
* Unifies and integrates a diverse coalition of stakeholders to drive synergies and cultivate deep, enduring customer relationships
* Shapes SE teams, engineering teams and leadership to develop innovative knowledge-sharing frameworks, and steer cross-functional educational strategies
* Drives organizational agility by developing GTM-wide market adaptation strategies

**Minimum Qualifications:**  
Bachelors + 12 years of related
  
experience, or
  
Masters + 8 years of related
  
experience, or
  
PhD + 5 years of related experience
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Test Software Developer
jobs.description:
**OUR STORY**

  

**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**

  

**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**

  

**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**

**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**

**YOUR ROLE**

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented engineering professional to join our Test R&D Software Solution team within the Global Technology R&D organization. You will be responsible for developing automation and robotics solutions, overseeing the development of all software applications. You will work in an international, multidisciplinary, and multicultural environment, interacting with factories, IT, product groups, quality, finance, suppliers, and executive management.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

You will be contributing to implementing ST's vision and roadmap towards Industry 4.0 with below key responsibilities:

* Analyzing processes to automate them using standard technology bricks
* Developing prototypes and software solutions internally or through external suppliers
* Conducting technical and economic benchmarks between different software solutions
* Building and coordinating software development projects, evaluating their costs, benefits, risks, and issues
* Reporting the project status to executive managers
  

**YOUR SKILLS & EXPERIENCES**

* Master's degree in computer engineering, electronic engineering, computer science
* Excellent knowledge of the English language, both written and spoken
* Knowledge of C#, C++ languages and solid foundations in object-oriented programming
* Knowledge of Java
* Knowledge of Python
* Knowledge of Git and versioning in general
* Knowledge of databases and SQL, SQLite languages
* Knowledge of XML and XSD formats
* 1-2 years' experience in the industrial automation sector, preferably in the semiconductor sector

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.

  
  

To discover more, visit st.com/careers.
